title: Governed ontology node continuous implementation plan
objective: Evolve the existing thin event-sourced ontology witness into a stable governed-node model whose canonical events calculate semantic and governance projections, then validate the complete candidate in one aggregate terminal wave.

preserved_evidence: The current event-sourcing contract compiles deterministically.
The current Rust witness has 12 focused passing tests.
Semantic and governance streams already have an exact-reference join candidate.
not_reopened: Whether projections are rebuildable read models rather than replay sources
Whether semantic and governance streams remain separate

included: governed ontology node and relation semantics
DomainSpec authored and deterministically compiled contracts
Rust reducer, projections, and exact ConstructionBinding
excluded: publication, release, deployment, or migration cutover
changes to the public Arcanum subsystem

waves.name: Select the governed-node architecture
waves.objective: Bind one immutable architecture decision before any successor design or implementation bytes change.

swus.primary_behavior: Produce the owner decision for the exact CAL-PROP-0004 digest.
done_criteria: The decision names the proposal digest.
The result is selected, amended-selected, or rejected.
Rejected stops the plan; amended-selected creates a new bound proposal digest.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic because it makes one authority-bearing architecture choice and changes no implementation.

gate.pass_condition: An exact-digest decision selects the governed-node envelope and semantic/governance stream split.

waves.name: Close definitions and schema semantics
waves.objective: Define the smallest stable node, relation, challenge-contract, and context-selector contract without implementation leakage.

swus.primary_behavior: Author canonical definitions for governed node identity, semantic state, governance state, challenge resolution, relation endpoints, context selection, confidence axes, and typed residue.
done_criteria: Each term has one canonical meaning and authority owner.
Semantic confidence, governance confidence, and evidence strength remain distinct.
ASD-STE100 guidance affects explanatory prose only, not identifier semantics.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic as one mutually dependent semantic vocabulary; splitting would leave schema terms undefined.

swus.primary_behavior: Author schemas and negative fixtures for nodes, relations, challenge contracts, context selectors, and exact cross-stream references.
done_criteria: All proposal-required challenge fields are represented.
Relations require valid typed endpoints.
Context membership is derived from explicit selectors.
Every required field has at least one rejecting negative fixture.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic because schemas and their falsifying witnesses define one acceptance surface.

gate.pass_condition: Definitions and schemas close over every selected proposal field and all negative fixtures fail for the intended reason.

waves.name: Align product capability and business ontology
waves.objective: Make the selected governed-node behavior an explicit product capability and capability-local business ontology before DomainSpec authoring.

swus.primary_behavior: Revise the Product Capability to state governed-node event calculation, challenge handling, and context-artifact projection behavior.
done_criteria: Behavior is user/product language, not Rust structure.
Every promised behavior maps to a W1 definition.
Acceptance remains owner-bound.

swus.primary_behavior: Revise the capability-local business ontology with governed node, relation, challenge, residue, and context-artifact relationships.
done_criteria: Concept and relation identifiers are unique.
All relation endpoints resolve.
Challenge and context relationships are explicit rather than prose-only.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic because the concept set and relationship closure must be reviewed together.

gate.owner: Product Capability and business ontology owners
gate.pass_condition: Both candidate artifacts bind the same definitions and have no unresolved endpoint or behavior mapping.

waves.name: Author DomainSpec and event-sourcing source
waves.objective: Represent the selected product and ontology semantics as authored DomainSpec source before compilation.

swus.primary_behavior: Extend the DomainSpec development source with governed-node types, relationships, invariants, selectors, and projection obligations.
done_criteria: Every W2 behavior has an authored source mapping.
No generated graph is hand-edited.
The development profile remains visibly candidate until admitted.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic as one dependency-closed authored source increment.

swus.primary_behavior: Extend the event-sourcing source with the selected streams, complete-state events, exact joins, projections, and runtime obligations.
done_criteria: Canonical events remain the replay source.
Node and relation latest snapshots are per subject.
Challenge governance joins by event id, digest, and commit position.
Context views declare consistent-cut selectors.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic because streams, events, joins, and projections form one compile contract.

gate.pass_condition: Authored source is dependency-closed, schema-valid, and traceable to W2 without touching generated outputs by hand.

waves.name: Compile the graph and system ontology deterministically
waves.objective: Produce byte-stable compiled graph, event contract, and system ontology from the exact authored source epoch.

swus.primary_behavior: Compile the DomainSpec graph, event-sourcing contract, and system ontology with source-bound receipts.
done_criteria: All outputs are generated from source.
Receipts bind exact source and compiler digests.
Two unchanged runs produce identical bytes.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic because all compiled artifacts must share one source epoch.

gate.owner: DomainSpec compiler and profile admission owners
gate.pass_condition: The exact profile/source epoch is admitted and two compiles yield identical outputs and receipts.

waves.name: Implement the governed-node runtime
waves.objective: Implement only the compiled contract in Rust: append validation, deterministic reduction, exact joins, and rebuildable projections.

swus.primary_behavior: Implement typed semantic and governance event payloads plus append-time invariant checks.
done_criteria: Payloads map exactly to compiled schemas.
Expected-version, event identity, ordering, and continuity checks fail closed.
No implementation-only semantic field exists.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic as the write-side contract and its falsifying tests.

swus.primary_behavior: Implement per-subject latest-state reducers and exact semantic-governance join validation.
done_criteria: Node and relation state comes from each subject stream's latest valid event.
Governance cannot mutate semantic state.
Wrong event id, digest, or commit position is rejected.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic because reducer state and cross-stream join consistency are one state-transition behavior.

swus.primary_behavior: Implement ontology-at-cursor, governed-node, and context-artifact projections from canonical events.
done_criteria: All views rebuild from empty state.
A global commit-position cut prevents fractured context views.
No projection or snapshot is accepted as canonical replay input.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic because the three read models share one consistency-cut and replay-source rule.

gate.pass_condition: All positive, negative, replay-equality, and projection-source tests pass against the W4 compiled epoch.

waves.name: Bind implementation and prove conformance
waves.objective: Bind every compiled obligation to exact Rust symbols and non-vacuous evidence, while exposing all residue.

swus.primary_behavior: Produce an exact ConstructionBinding from definitions and compiled obligations to implementation symbols and tests.
done_criteria: Every compiled obligation has at least one implementation symbol and test.
Every bound digest is current.
Unbound symbols and obligations are reported rather than omitted.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic because partial binding would overstate implementation conformance.

swus.primary_behavior: Run an independent conformance and vacuity audit for the exact W4/W5 epoch.
done_criteria: Each negative witness demonstrably trips its intended invariant.
Dependent checks are not_evaluable when a predecessor fails.
Known residue is explicit and acceptance-critical residue is classified.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic as an independent evidence verdict over one immutable candidate epoch.

gate.owner: independent validation and human acceptance owners
gate.pass_condition: Conformance evidence passes, vacuity mutations fail as expected, binding is current, and the exact candidate is explicitly accepted for migration rehearsal.

waves.name: Rehearse bounded legacy migration
waves.objective: Test an allowlisted legacy slice against the accepted candidate in isolation without mutating legacy sources or cutting over.

swus.primary_behavior: Create an exact legacy inventory and mapping manifest for one owner-selected ontology slice.
done_criteria: Every input path and digest is allowlisted.
Every legacy shape is mapped, rejected, or carried as typed residue.
The manifest grants no cutover authority.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic as one source-bound migration manifest.

swus.primary_behavior: Replay the allowlisted legacy slice into an isolated empty event store and compare rebuilt projections.
done_criteria: Legacy sources remain unchanged.
Every output event has lineage.
Projection bytes match the manifest expectation.
No live cutover or publication occurs.
swus.split_analysis: Atomic as one isolated rehearsal and receipt.

gate.pass_condition: The allowlisted rehearsal targets the exact accepted W6 candidate, is lineage-complete, deterministic, non-destructive, and has no unclassified input.

waves.name: Validate the complete candidate epoch
waves.objective: Run one collect-all aggregate validation over frozen W0-W7 bytes and issue a candidate verdict with an explicit authority ceiling.

swus.primary_behavior: Execute and join every declared final validation against one immutable source epoch.
done_criteria: All W0-W7 gates have passing receipts.
All required validation ids run even when a predecessor blocks, with dependent results marked not_evaluable.
Two-run outputs are byte-identical.
Acceptance-critical residue is empty for PASS.
The verdict states that PASS is candidate evidence, not admission, publication, deployment, or cutover authority.
swus.split_analysis: Indivisible terminal join: splitting the aggregate would permit partial PASS claims across different epochs.

gate.pass_condition: Every required check passes against the same frozen epoch and acceptance-critical residue is empty.

final_validation.pass_condition: All required checks PASS on one frozen epoch, all predecessor gates PASS, no selected source digest drifts, and acceptance-critical residue is empty.
